subject: Aligning on budget owner + security intake for Redwood trial
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@synapsehealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps from today's demo — trial, procurement path

Hi Alex — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Trial scope: 3 internal teams (Clinical Ops, Data Science, Patient Messaging). Redwood hosted trial for 90 days, dedicated model variant for PII redaction.
- Success criteria: <10% false positives on redaction tests, stable 95th percentile latency < 350ms for 512-token requests.
- Security/Compliance ask: Synapse requested SOC2 evidence and a short questionnaire (see note below).
- Procurement: Alex mentioned an internal procurement review and a separate budget owner for integration spend.

Can you introduce the budget owner and your security/compliance reviewer so we can align timelines? Suggested next step from our side: a 30-min sync between your budget owner, your security lead, and our IR + product ops to run through cost model, SOW outline, and the questionnaire. 

Irene and Connor are copied — Irene will lead the procurement checklist and Connor will scope the onboarding plan if we get a pilot go-ahead.

Attachments: we have a short compliance brief and a draft SOW I can share once we have the right contacts.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment stub: Redwood_Compliance_Brief_v1.pdf (PDF, 68KB)]

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@synapsehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps from today's demo — trial, procurement path

Marissa — appreciated the demo. Looping in the contacts you requested: 

- Priya Shah (Finance & Budget Owner) — priya.shah@synapsehealth.com
- Daniel Rees (InfoSec, leads vendor assessments) — daniel.rees@synapsehealth.com
- procurement@synapsehealth.com (shared mailbox for contracts)

Priya and Daniel, brief note: Redwood Inference ran through a short pilot proposal and has follow-ups on cost breakdown and SOC2 artifacts. I attached the vendor questionnaire we use — could be useful as you review Redwood's answers. 

We'd like a 30-min alignment next week if possible. Priya, can you advise on what approvals are required on your side (CapEx vs OpEx, thresholds, PO process)? Daniel — if you need a redacted example of our data flow diagram, I can provide one.

Thanks,
Alex

[Attachment: Synapse_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 95KB)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@synapsehealth.com>, Daniel Rees <daniel.rees@synapsehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + proposed agenda: budget holder & security intake for trial (Redwood)

Hi Priya and Daniel — Irene here, head of Customer Operations at Redwood. Marissa looped you in — thanks Alex. I wanted to propose a short agenda to make the initial alignment as efficient as possible: 

1) Budget scope & approval path (10 min) — Priya: confirm whether this will go through CapEx approval or can be handled via an ops budget. Expected cost bands to compare.
2) Procurement steps & contract timing (5 min) — confirm PO/contract owner and typical review length.
3) Security evidence & gating (10 min) — Daniel: items you expect (SOC 2, pen test summary, data handling diagram, encryption in transit/at rest).
4) Pilot operations & handoff (5 min) — Connor will outline on-boarding checklist and timeline if pilot approved.

Proposed times (PT): Tue 2026-07-14 10:00–10:30, Wed 2026-07-15 14:00–14:30, Thu 2026-07-16 09:00–09:30. If none work, suggest alternatives and we'll accommodate.

I'm attaching a short SOW template and our compliance brief to give a sense of timelines and required artifacts. If you'd prefer, we can fill the Synapse questionnaire first and return it ahead of the call.

Best,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Head, Customer Operations | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai | +1 (510) 555-0299
[Attachment stub: Redwood_SOW_Template.pdf (PDF, 24KB)]
[Attachment stub: Redwood_Compliance_Brief_v1.pdf (PDF, 68KB)]

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@synapsehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Rees <daniel.rees@synapsehealth.com>, procurement@synapsehealth.com
Date: 2026-07-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed agenda: budget holder & security intake for trial (Redwood)

Thanks Irene — happy to align. Tue 7/14 10:00 PT works for me. I've CC'd procurement and Daniel for intake. A few quick notes before the call: 

- Approval path: anything under $50k typically goes through ops sign-off and a single budget owner; above that requires Finance director review (I own the initial approval).
- PO/Contract: procurement will need our standard redlines; please include your liability cap and data residency language up front so we can vet before the call.
- Questionnaire: please complete the Synapse_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx and return it to procurement@synapsehealth.com ahead of the call — that speeds review.

I've added a HubSpot ticket for the project (HS-4981) and put a placeholder meeting on the calendar for Tue 7/14 10:00 PT. Look forward to the chat.

Best,
Priya Shah
Finance Manager — Vendor Approvals
Priya.Shah@synapsehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0789

[HubSpot ticket: HS-4981]
